استبطنوا (form X)
# اِسْتَبْطَنُوا (istabṭanū) /is.tab.tˤa.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَبْطَنَ (istabṭana)
# اِسْتَبْطِنُوا (istabṭinū) /is.tab.tˤi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَبْطَنَ (istabṭana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
